selection: Plain muted indigo-grey everyday kosode/kimono-style robe to just above ankles, modest sleeves, narrow dark obi and simple straw sandals. No decorative pattern, large rear bow, crest, sword, hat or outer ceremonial layer.
historical_basis: Everyday robe silhouettes in inspected Hiroshige1857 street print, with construction and ordinary/elite distinctions from V&A and MIA. Treat as a simple adaptation, not a copy of a wedding or theatre garment.
identity_lock: Preserve Visitor's skin tone, face, eyes, hair, proportions, expressions and linework. No shaved forelock, topknot, beard or ethnic transformation.
continuity: Wearer's LEFT front panel over RIGHT in every pose; never mirror a finished garment derivative without correcting closure. Plain narrow obi remains at same relative height. Outfit stays visually quiet.
production_review: Private variants only, one standing and one close-up pilot inspected against source silhouette and full composites. No shared-library modifications.
